name: named-spec
query: goldfish the agent team spec before we start building it
why: The skill's own verb with a spec named in words.

name: ready-to-build
query: is tasks/SPEC-WEB-ACCESS.md clear enough that a fresh session could implement it without asking me anything? have something with no context poke holes in it
why: The situation, not the name: a spec about to be built, checked for ambiguity by a fresh reader.

name: plan-ambiguity
query: before we implement, have a fresh reviewer check the spec and the handoff plan for anything ambiguous or that only makes sense with this session's context
why: Pre-build ambiguity check on a spec and plan, phrased without the skill's name.

name: code-review
query: review the diff on this branch for bugs before I merge it
why: Reviewing code is a code review, not a spec review.

name: strategy
query: ask the advisor whether the phase order in this plan is right
why: Judging a plan's strategy belongs to the advisor.

name: write-spec
query: write a spec for a CSV export feature
why: Writing a spec is not reviewing one.

name: goldfish-readme
query: goldfish the README against the code
why: The skill's own verb on documentation rather than a spec.

name: readme-drift
query: does README.md still match what the CLI actually does? have a fresh reader check every command and flag it documents against the script
why: Doc mode by situation: a cold check of documentation against its code, without the skill's name.

name: write-readme
query: write a README for this repo
why: Writing documentation is not reviewing it.
